tasks.name: Stakeholder & User Requirements Capture
tasks.description: Interview 2‑3 small‑business users; document the 80/20 core feature set.
tasks.acceptance: Markdown requirements document with ≤12 items, each with a brief rationale.

tasks.name: Technical Feasibility Review
tasks.description: Evaluate Vite + TS + Tailwind, react‑virtual, xlsx, papaparse, html2pdf.js, Lucide icons.
tasks.acceptance: Markdown matrix with pros, cons, risk level, and Go/No‑Go decision for each dependency.

tasks.name: Repository & CI Scaffold
tasks.description: Create GitHub repo, .gitignore, README, and GitHub Actions CI workflow.
tasks.acceptance: CI pipeline runs on push, lint, type‑check, and tests pass.

tasks.name: Project Boilerplate Confirmation
tasks.description: Add Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, ESLint, Prettier configs and CDN script tag.
tasks.acceptance: npm run dev launches a clean UI with Tailwind loaded and no console errors.
tasks.outputFormat: All source files as separate fenced code blocks

tasks.name: State Model Design
tasks.description: Define TypeScript interfaces for Workbook, Sheet, Cell, CellStyle, HistoryEntry, Selection.
tasks.acceptance: src/types.ts compiles without errors; unit test verifies instantiation.

tasks.name: Virtualized Grid Component
tasks.description: Implement Grid using react‑virtual; support at least 10 k rows with smooth scrolling.
tasks.acceptance: Scrolling through 10 k rows is fluid and grid renders correctly.

tasks.name: Cell Editing UI
tasks.description: Add CellEditor component, formula bar, and auto‑detect data types.
tasks.acceptance: User can edit a cell, see the formula bar update, and value persists in state.

tasks.name: Copy / Paste & Drag‑Fill
tasks.description: Clipboard handling for cells/ranges and fill‑handle for series extension.
tasks.acceptance: Copy‑paste works across cells; drag‑fill correctly increments numbers/dates.

tasks.name: Undo / Redo Stack
tasks.description: React Context based history with undo/redo actions and toolbar buttons.
tasks.acceptance: Undo/redo revert up to 50 actions; UI buttons functional.

tasks.name: Cell Merging
tasks.description: Support merging of selected ranges into a single cell with rowSpan/colSpan.
tasks.acceptance: User can merge and unmerge a range; merged cell renders correctly.

tasks.name: Column & Row Resizing
tasks.description: Add draggable resize handles to column headers and row numbers; persist dimensions in state.
tasks.acceptance: User can drag a header edge and column/row width/height updates instantly.

tasks.name: Freeze Panes
tasks.description: Toolbar toggle to freeze top row and/or left column; keep them visible while scrolling.
tasks.acceptance: Frozen rows/columns stay fixed during scroll and UI reflects frozen state.

tasks.name: Formula Parser
tasks.description: Parse A1‑style formulas into an AST; support arithmetic and core functions.
tasks.acceptance: parseFormula returns correct AST for valid formulas and throws informative errors otherwise.

tasks.name: Formula Evaluator & Dependency Graph
tasks.description: Compute cell values from AST, manage dependencies, detect circular references.
tasks.acceptance: Immediate recompute on changes; circular reference shows #CIRC!; performance ≤10 ms for 5 k cells.

tasks.name: Excel (.xlsx) Import Service
tasks.description: Read .xlsx files, extract sheets, values, simple formulas, and basic formatting.
tasks.acceptance: Uploading a valid .xlsx populates the grid correctly; toast on success.

tasks.name: Excel (.xlsx) Export Service
tasks.description: Write current workbook to .xlsx preserving values, formulas, and basic formatting.
tasks.acceptance: Exported file opens in Excel with matching data and formulas.

tasks.name: CSV / TSV Import & Export
tasks.description: Use papaparse to import/export CSV and TSV files.
tasks.acceptance: Round‑trip CSV preserves all cell values; TSV works similarly.

tasks.name: Plain‑Text (TSV) Import / Export
tasks.description: Support .txt files with tab delimiters for import/export.
tasks.acceptance: Importing a .txt loads data correctly; exporting produces a proper TSV file.

tasks.name: JSON Import / Export
tasks.description: Serialize/deserialize the full Workbook, including merges, freezes, column widths, etc.
tasks.acceptance: Exported JSON can be re‑imported to restore the workbook exactly.

tasks.name: Page Setup UI
tasks.description: Allow user to set orientation, margins, scaling, and printable area.
tasks.acceptance: Settings persist in context and affect the print preview.

tasks.name: PDF Generation
tasks.description: Generate PDF from printable view using html2pdf.js, respecting page‑setup settings.
tasks.acceptance: Exported PDF matches on‑screen preview with correct orientation and margins.

tasks.name: Unit & Integration Tests
tasks.description: Jest + React Testing Library tests for core data model, formula engine, and import/export services.
tasks.acceptance: All tests pass; coverage ≥ 80 % for targeted modules.

tasks.name: Cypress End‑to‑End Tests
tasks.description: E2E flow: create sheet, edit cells, use formula, undo, export/import CSV, generate PDF.
tasks.acceptance: Cypress run finishes with zero failures; screenshots captured on error.

tasks.name: Performance Benchmark
tasks.description: Measure grid rendering time, scrolling FPS, and export latency on a 10 k‑row sheet.
tasks.acceptance: FPS ≥ 55 and export latency ≤ 2 s; results logged to console.

tasks.name: Production Build & Deployment
tasks.description: Vite production build and static hosting configuration (Netlify or Vercel).
tasks.acceptance: Live HTTPS URL with no console errors; gzipped bundle ≤ 1 MB.
